status_note: Canon starter spell, ruled in by Roc 2026-08-05 with an amended effect: it soothes itches in unreachable places. The GDD fixes scratch's component (wool) but never stated its effect, so the amendment adds to canon rather than contradicting it.
learn_source: Watch the postman pause at a fencepost mid-route under the full festival mailbag — the strap-itch between the shoulder blades that no hand reaches, cast away without ever setting the bag down
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on an itch out of reach once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the relief is complete and the itch stays gone; at baseline it dulls and creeps back before long. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: The itch between the shoulder blades, where no hand reaches, subsides; the skin settles flat
receivers.reaction_kind: shoulders drop and roll once, then back to the work at hand

receivers.physical_outcome: no_effect — nothing itches anywhere on him, so there is nothing to soothe
receivers.reaction_kind: pats himself down hunting for whatever was supposed to happen

receivers.physical_outcome: The deep itch behind the ear its hind leg could never reach subsides; the leg stops mid-scratch
receivers.reaction_kind: one last reflex kick, then flops down and settles

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: still knitting, the itch around the scab quiets and the scab stays unbroken; long healed over, nothing itches and nothing happens
